title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1966-09-16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a tight ’66 show with a smoking Midnight Hour and an energetic Dancing in the Streets jam.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as one of the strongest from 1966 – tight playing, solid vocals and standout Pigpen moments like Midnight Hour and a fiery Dancing in the Streets improvisation. The soundboard source sounds clear for its era with only minor clipping or white‑noise on a few cuts, making it very listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 5 stars and highlighted both high musical quality and generally good audio; minor clipping prevents a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mostly clear for a 1966 tape; occasional clipped/buzzy sections and light white‑noise, but overall balanced and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as tight and well‑structured, with strong vocal work and energetic jams that keep the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great soloing, especially in the Dancing in the Streets jam; tearing it up on It Hurts Me Too.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals and overall sound are notably better than many ’66 recordings; his playing has matured.
